input.question: Which person or organization did Tingju Zhu work for?

documents.text: As Dr. Sophia Patel made her way through the bustling corridors of Royal Gwent Hospital, she couldn't help but notice the peculiar aroma wafting from the research wing. It was a scent she had grown accustomed to over the years - a mix of stale coffee, worn-out textbooks, and the faint hint of curiosity. She followed the scent to the door with the faded sign that read "Research and Development" and pushed it open. Inside, the room was a marvel of organized chaos. Shelves upon shelves of dusty journals and dog-eared textbooks seemed to stretch up to the ceiling, while various contraptions and gadgets whirred and beeped in the background. Amidst the clutter, a figure hunched over a microscope, their dark hair tied back in a neat ponytail. Dr. Patel's eyes landed on the name tag: Tingju Zhu, Researcher. Tingju looked up, startled, as Dr. Patel approached. "Ah, Sophia! I didn't hear you come in," they said, their voice tinged with a hint of a Chinese accent. Dr. Patel smiled, noting the faint smudge of graphite on Tingju's left eyebrow - a telltale sign of their late-night sketching sessions. "What's got you so engrossed?" Dr. Patel asked, peering over Tingju's shoulder at the microscope slide. Tingju's eyes lit up as they began to explain their latest project, a revolutionary new treatment for antibiotic-resistant infections. Dr. Patel listened intently, her mind racing with the possibilities. As they chatted, Dr. Patel couldn't help but think back to the countless times Tingju had saved the hospital from the brink of disaster with their innovative solutions. There was the time they had developed a makeshift ventilator using spare parts from the hospital's maintenance closet, or the way they had hacked together a makeshift diagnostic tool using an old smartphone and some spare code. Tingju Zhu might have been a researcher, but to Dr. Patel, they were so much more - a guardian angel of sorts, watching over the hospital and its patients with a fierce dedication.
